events.title: Deadline passes for Jews to leave Spain under the Alhambra Decree
events.description: The last day allowed by Ferdinand and Isabella's expulsion edict passed, and Spain's Jewish communities left or converted. Tens of thousands went into exile, founding the Sephardic diaspora.
events.html: The last day allowed by Ferdinand and Isabella's expulsion edict passed, and Spain's Jewish communities left or converted. Tens of thousands went into exile, founding the Sephardic diaspora.

events.title: Ignatius of Loyola dies in Rome
events.description: Ignatius of Loyola, the Basque soldier turned founder of the Society of Jesus, died in Rome. His Spiritual Exercises and the Jesuits' schools and missions reshaped Catholicism worldwide.
events.html: Ignatius of Loyola, the Basque soldier turned founder of the Society of Jesus, died in Rome. His Spiritual Exercises and the Jesuits' schools and missions reshaped Catholicism worldwide.

events.title: Daniel Defoe stands in the pillory for seditious libel
events.description: Daniel Defoe began three days in the pillory for a satirical pamphlet mocking Tory hostility to Dissenters. By tradition the crowd threw flowers instead of filth. He later wrote Robinson Crusoe.
events.html: Daniel Defoe began three days in the pillory for a satirical pamphlet mocking Tory hostility to Dissenters. By tradition the crowd threw flowers instead of filth. He later wrote Robinson Crusoe.

events.title: The first US patent is issued to Samuel Hopkins
events.description: Samuel Hopkins received the first patent under the new US Patent Act, for an improved way of making potash. It was signed by George Washington and Thomas Jefferson.
events.html: Samuel Hopkins received the first patent under the new US Patent Act, for an improved way of making potash. It was signed by George Washington and Thomas Jefferson.

events.title: The Battle of Passchendaele begins
events.description: British and French forces opened the Third Battle of Ypres in Flanders. Heavy rain turned the battlefield into a swamp, and months of fighting won a few miles for hundreds of thousands of casualties.
events.html: British and French forces opened the Third Battle of Ypres in Flanders. Heavy rain turned the battlefield into a swamp, and months of fighting won a few miles for hundreds of thousands of casualties.

events.title: Apollo 15 astronauts drive the first rover on the Moon
events.description: David Scott and James Irwin took the battery-powered Lunar Roving Vehicle on its first drive near Hadley Rille. The rover let astronauts range much farther from their lander to collect samples.
events.html: David Scott and James Irwin took the battery-powered Lunar Roving Vehicle on its first drive near Hadley Rille. The rover let astronauts range much farther from their lander to collect samples.
